description: Search news across the web in one call: Google News RSS, Bing News RSS and GDELT's Context 2.0 API (public, no keys), merged, de-duplicated by headline and sorted newest first. Each item has title, publisher, URL, time and which engines found it, plus a per-engine status. Headlines and snippets only, no full text. Google links are Google News redirect links. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

engines.description: Comma-separated: google, bing, gdelt (default all three)
